wstep: This card describes the NCHFP recipe for zucchini-pineapple: zucchini cooked in canned pineapple juice with bottled lemon juice and sugar, hot packed and processed in a boiling-water bath.

sekcje.naglowek: Why you must not change the recipe
akapity: Zucchini is a low-acid food with a pH above 4.6.
The FDA list gives cooked zucchini a pH of about 5.69–6.10.
The whole product must contain a minimum, uniform level of acid so that botulism bacteria cannot grow.
JarAtlas rule (cautious): do not change the amounts of bottled lemon juice, pineapple juice or zucchini; the recipe is tested only in the proportions given.
NCHFP uses US measures: a cup holds about 237 ml.
For about 8 to 9 pint jars NCHFP lists 4 quarts (about 3.8 l) of cubed or shredded zucchini, 46 ounces of canned unsweetened pineapple juice, 1 1/2 cups of bottled lemon juice and 3 cups of sugar.
JarAtlas counts the 46 ounces of juice as US fluid ounces, about 1.36 l; this is the larger of the two possible readings, so it means more acidic juice, not less.
Peel the zucchini and either cut it into 1/2-inch (about 1.3 cm) cubes or shred it.
Mix the zucchini with the other ingredients in a large saucepan and bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Fill the jars with the hot mixture and cooking liquid, leaving 1/2 inch (about 1.3 cm) of headspace.
Put on the lids and process.
At 0–1000 ft (up to 300 m) process half-pint and pint jars in a boiling-water bath for 15 minutes.
Above 1000 ft the food may spoil if the time is not increased.
At 1001–6000 ft (above 300 m up to 1800 m) process them for 20 minutes.
Above 6000 ft (above 1800 m) process them for 25 minutes.
The card converts feet to metres and rounds the limits down, towards the longer time: 1000 ft becomes 300 m and 6000 ft becomes 1800 m.
Shortening the time or cooling jars in cold water can also lead to spoilage.
The NCHFP table gives times only for half-pint and pint jars.
JarAtlas rule (NCHFP does not test metric jars): a pint holds about 473 ml, so a 0.5 l jar has no tested time in this recipe; use jars of up to 473 ml.
